title: work-state.json (schema 3) — F4
description: Canonical, self-contained snapshot of a Work. Authority over the Work's persisted state (ADR-0013). Written only by the core, atomically (temp + rename). Plugins never read or write this file. Schema 3 is an additive superset of schema 2: start_mode gains 'contribution' and 'fork', and slug and branch_convention both become required unless start_mode == 'contribution' (in which case both MUST be absent, since contribution mode never runs the slug or convention steps — FR-020), mirroring the archived_at-iff-archived conditional schema 2 already established. Readers accept schema 1, 2, or 3; writers always emit 3 (see specs/002-daily-cycle/contracts/work-state.schema.json for schema 2 and specs/001-first-local-work/contracts/work-state.schema.json for schema 1).

schema.description: Schema version. F4 emits 3. A schema-1 or schema-2 file is also a valid input (see their own contracts).

work.description: Core-governed domain state. Plugins cannot create or write keys here.

id.description: Opaque, sortable, stable identity generated at creation (ULID). Unchanged from F1/F2.

slug.description: Short human-readable identifier chosen by the user at creation. Required in 'new' and 'fork' mode (unchanged meaning from F1/F2). MUST be absent in 'contribution' mode: the slug step never runs (FR-020) — the branch and directory naming both derive from the Starter-resolved branch instead.

archived_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Present if and only if status == 'archived'. Unchanged from F2.

start_mode.description: 'new': start_modes was absent from the Starter response (unchanged F1/F3 meaning). 'fork': start_modes was present and the user selected fork — the identical new-Work journey as 'new', just Starter-provided. 'contribution': start_modes was present and the user selected contribution — the Starter-resolved branch was checked out directly as a local branch, no new branch name was chosen by this Work.

starter.description: Logical name of the Starter that resolved the source. Unchanged from F1, now may name a plugin-provided Starter (qualified '<alias>/<name>' when the bare name collides across enabled packages).

branch.description: In 'new'/'fork' mode: the branch this Work created. In 'contribution' mode: the local branch the Starter resolved and this Work checked out, recorded by its local name (never a '<remote>/<name>' reference). A branch that existed locally before the run is never deleted on rollback; a local tracking branch created by the run for a remote-only branch is (FR-020, FR-033).

base_branch.description: In 'new'/'fork' mode: short name of the base ref the branch was started from. In 'contribution' mode: the same value as 'branch' — there is no separate base, since no new branch was created; the field still records what was checked out.

branch_convention.description: Resolved convention name. Required in 'new' and 'fork' mode (unchanged meaning from F1/F2). MUST be absent in 'contribution' mode: branch convention is neither an input nor an output of contribution mode (ADD §7/§8, FR-020).

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Set once at creation. Unchanged from F1/F2.

last_accessed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC. Unchanged mutability rules from F2.

meta.description: Extensible metadata published by components. Empty in F4 (a Starter's meta output is accepted on the wire but not yet persisted — F5 scope).

links.description: First-class external relations, one value per semantic key. Empty in F4 (a Starter's links output is accepted on the wire but not yet persisted — F5 scope).
